required_behavior: Create one authoritative immutable unit baseline before the first code attempt. Never replace it implicitly with a retry's immediate workspace.

Collect every attempt's complete accumulated workspace delta against that baseline, including additions, modifications, deletions and relevant file metadata. Enforce the selected card's allowed paths against that accumulated delta.

After a failed attempt, retain mutation evidence and block retry when unauthorized changes remain. Require explicit supervised restoration or reconciliation with recorded evidence; ordinary retry must not adopt those changes as a new baseline.

Give shell-disabled planning workers actual immutable source contents and bootstrap evidence contents. Give review workers original and resulting contents for the complete accumulated change, deleted-file originals, relevant surrounding source and actual required evidence.

Use a manifest binding every supplied context item to its path, kind, digest and source revision. Apply explicit bounded payload limits; fail closed for missing, unreadable, unrepresentable or oversized required context. Never silently truncate or substitute worker summaries for source or evidence.
Require review launch input to equal the collected code revision. Bind the review request and result to that exact revision and context manifest.
